fact: INTIC's 2022 annual report states that a mid-term monitoring and evaluation of the PEOSI 2019-2023 (120 projects) was carried out in 2021 and updated in 2022, with submission to the Council of Ministers expected in Q4 2022; it gives no execution figures.
title: Relatório de Actividades de 2022 do INTIC, IP.
publisher: INTIC, IP (Instituto Nacional das Tecnologias de Informação e Comunicação)
